mainEntity.name: How long does it take to get custom interior doors installed?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for custom interior door installation can range from several weeks to a few months, depending on the complexity of the design, material availability, and current production schedules. Manufacturing intricate designs or sourcing unique materials will naturally extend the lead time. After fabrication, the actual installation typically takes one to several days per door, based on the frame preparation required. We will provide a detailed project timeline during your initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation timelines for custom interior doors vary from weeks to months, depending on design complexity and material availability. Installation itself takes 1-several days per door.
